messages:
jordan_customer: seeing 403s from our staging service after the key rotation earlier today. started ~09:12 UTC. only affects EU region. curl to /v1/generate returns "authorization failed". no deploys on our side.

maria_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact error and short curl you ran? also which auth mode (apikey in env, vault, or sso)?

jordan_customer: here's minimal repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 403 JSON: `{"error":{"code":"unauthorized","message":"api key revoked or not found"}}`. API_KEY comes from k8s env var populated from Vault sidecar (kv-v2).

maria_support: thanks. can you confirm vault path (kv-v2 versioned) and whether you rotated to a new key id or revoked the old?

jordan_customer: rotation: created new secret at `secret/data/prod/eu/api-key` and then set `redwood_key` to new value in Vault, then rolled the sidecar config. We did a staged rollout (canary -> rest). Some canaries show 200, most pods 403.

sam_oncall: adding logs from our edge: `edge-auth: token lookup returned not_found for key_id xxxxx` and some `key_revoked` events. Also saw `vault-agent: cached secret v1 -> stale` in sidecar metrics.

tim_engineering: this sounds like a propagation race between Vault KV versioning + sidecar cache TTL + edge auth cache. If the edge auths against KMS-wrapped key id but the sidecar returned the new plaintext without rewrap metadata, edge might reject. Does your sidecar do local caching of the secret file?

jordan_customer: yes sidecar writes `/etc/secrets/redwood_key` and we mount into app. We didn't restart the app pods, only sidecar. Some clients keep old connection pools that read the file once at start.

maria_support: short term workaround: rotate the key back to previous active value or restart the app containers to pick up the new file. Can you try restarting one failing pod?

jordan_customer: restarted one pod, it started returning 200. restarting whole deployment fixed the service. concern: this will happen again on future rotations.

sam_oncall: we've flagged a related incident: edge and auth service should do key-by-key lookup tolerant to both old and new keys during staged rotations. Also sidecar should emit a restart-needed signal when file changes.

tim_engineering: next steps for root cause: 1) confirm Vault kv-v2 behavior: new write creates new version but some controllers read latest metadata differently. 2) sidecar cache TTL default 5m — if we wrote file but didn't notify app, app continues to use old in-memory token. 3) edge auth caches key id -> allowlist for 2m. Staged rollout meant some edges hit still-revoked id.

maria_support: capturing repro steps for engineering: 1) write new secret to kv-v2 2) update sidecar to fetch and write file (no app restart) 3) perform rollout where only sidecar is restarted 4) observe 403s on clients with long-lived connection pools 5) edge logs show `key_not_found` and `key_revoked` for old key ids.

tim_engineering: proposed fixes: 1) patch sidecar to send SIGHUP or small POST to app when secret file is rotated (opt-in), 2) update docs: recommend app reload pattern or watch file, 3) edge auth: accept previous key for a short grace window during rotation and log mismatches.

sam_oncall: I'm opening a follow-up ticket to prioritize sidecar change and an edge gate to support grace windows. Ticket: ENG-rotation-1721.

maria_support: jordan_customer — for now keep full deployment restart as mitigation and we'll push docs and a short-term script to rollout safely. sorry for the disruption. :pray:

jordan_customer: thanks team — restart worked. please let us know when patch is available or if you want us to test a canary.

vault-bot: vault: secret `secret/data/prod/eu/api-key` written at 2026-03-17T09:05:12Z (version 5).
